 Davion Mitchell fills stat sheet Wednesday against Clippers 
 by Chris Schommer | Heat Correspondent | Thu, Nov 5th 2026, 8:16pm EST 
 Davion Mitchell filled the stat sheet for the Heat Wednesday night, dishing out 10 assists, recording four steals, grabbing two rebounds, blocking one shot, and chipping in 11 points (5-13 FG, 0-5 3PT, 1-1 FT) in a 117-116 win over the Clippers. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Mitchell continues a solid stretch on the offensive end of the floor, finishing with two or more assists and 10 or more points in each of his last five contests. The guard has offered head coach Erik Spoelstra another stable option as part of a revamped Miami starting five early on, averaging 15.4 points and 8.3 assists per game to go along with a usage rate of 17.7% so far this season.
